title: Predictive Closure: A Set-Level Characterization of JEPA's Feature Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.27364v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPA), an encoder and a predictor are trained together to produce a representation that minimizes the error in predicting the representation of the next observation. Because the representations of both the current and the next observation are learned, it is unclear which features they will include. Earlier characterizations describe the features JEPA selects in terms of their individual predictability, raising the concern that unpredictable features, like a traffic light, will not be encoded into the representation. However, the prediction error is also affected by the relationships between features, e.g., the light's color helps predict whether the traffic will stop. We propose the predictive closure characterization, which accounts for these relationships. Based on a reformulation of the JEPA training objective, we show that selection depends on properties of feature sets. This view agrees

translated_title: 预测闭合：对JEPA特征选择的集合层面刻画
translated_abstract: 在联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）中，编码器和预测器被一起训练，以产生一个能够最小化对下一观测的表示预测误差的表示。由于当前观测和下一观测的表示都是通过学习得到的，因此并不清楚它们将包含哪些特征。早期的刻画以单个特征自身的可预测性来描述JEPA所选择的特征，这引发了一种担忧：不可预测的特征（例如交通灯）将不会被编码进表示中。然而，预测误差还会受到特征之间关系的影响，例如，灯的颜色有助于预测交通是否会停止。我们提出了预测闭合这一刻画方式，它将这些关系纳入考量。基于对JEPA训练目标的重新表述，我们证明了特征选择取决于特征集合的性质。这一观点与……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了“预测闭合”这一新刻画，证明JEPA的特征选择取决于特征集合层面的整体性质（即特征间的关系），而非单个特征的可预测性，从而化解了不可预测特征（如交通灯）不会被编码进表示的担忧。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the predictive closure characterization, showing that JEPA's feature selection depends on set-level properties arising from relationships between features rather than on the individual predictability of each feature.
